title: Two deer killed by suspected poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer; villagers stage protest

ai.summary: Villagers in Rajasthan's Barmer staged a sit-in protest demanding the arrest of suspected poachers who allegedly killed two deer and tied one carcass before hanging it upside down.

facts.claim: Two deer were allegedly killed by poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer district, triggering protests by villagers demanding the immediate arrest of those responsible, officials said.
facts.quote: Two deer were allegedly killed by poachers in Rajasthan's Barmer district, triggering protests by villagers demanding the immediate arrest of those responsible, officials said.

facts.claim: According to villagers, the suspected poachers killed two deer and allegedly tied the legs of one carcass before hanging it upside down from a tree.
facts.quote: According to villagers, the suspected poachers killed two deer and allegedly tied the legs of one carcass before hanging it upside down from a tree.

facts.claim: The incident occurred on Friday night near Nehron Ki Nadi and Bisarniya villages in the Dhanau police station area.
facts.quote: The incident occurred on Friday night near Nehron Ki Nadi and Bisarniya villages in the Dhanau police station area.

facts.claim: Villagers alleged that the poachers were using an iron container filled with stones to produce sounds to attract deer.
facts.quote: Villagers alleged that the poachers were using an iron container filled with stones to produce sounds to attract deer.

facts.claim: Following the incident, villagers gathered and began a sit-in protest, demanding the arrest of the accused and stronger measures to protect wildlife.
facts.quote: Following the incident, villagers gathered and began a sit-in protest, demanding the arrest of the accused and stronger measures to protect wildlife.
